items.title: Short Short Fest & Best of July Prizes
items.content_html: Short Short FestThis Saturday is Short Short Fest in PA! There’s a new venue this year: Shankweiler's Drive-In Theatre. PA is no longer a free event and it’s recommended to buy tickets in advance.What’s cool is that if you stick around after the festival, your ticket includes Spider-Man: Brand New Day at 10:30pm! Chill outside with a bunch of us animation fans AND see the new Spider-Man. @NickSenny has been managing a list of anticipated NG attendees.If you can’t make it to PA, Short Short Fest will be in Michigan on August 15th and CA on September 19th.Best of JulyVoting for the Best of July begins this Friday! We are bumping up the movie and game prizes again.Top Ten Movies: $500, $300, $250, $200, $100 for 5th-10th, $200 for Best OriginalTop Ten Games: $500, $300, $250, $200, $100 for 5th-10th, $200 for Best OriginalThis means if the top movie or game is based on original material, it can win as much as $700.Music and Art prizes are currently set to remain the same as last month but we’re adding a $100 “Best Original” bonus like we have with the other categories. This means the top-ranked piece based on original material will receive an extra $100.Top Ten Music: $100 each for 1st-5th, $50 each for 6th-10th + $100 for Best OriginalTop Ten Art: $100 for First Place, $50 each for 2nd-10th + $100 for Best OriginalSigny & Mino is now out on Steam and is one of our prize sponsors this month, along with Lucky Tower Ultimate, Matt’s games, Cult of the Lamb, Among Us and Geometry Dash!The rest is thanks to your Support! If you're already a Supporter, be sure to share something on the front page for Takeover Tuesday today.FundraisersIf you’ve ever enjoyed @Jazza’s works on NG, or his Draw with Jazza channel, please consider donating to his GoFundMe to support his wife through her cancer treatment. 🎵 Audio Portal Now Accepts Lots More FormatsThe Audio Portal now accepts the m4a, ogg vorbis and ogg opus formats in addition to mp3. If you are a Supporter you can upload lossless formats like flac, wav, aiff, aif, flac in ogg and Apple Lossless inside an m4a. We generate an mp3 for web streaming, while making both the mp3 and lossless file available for download if you have downloads turned on.Other News@jamriot has announced the Writer’s Jam 2026 Winners!@AEDA has kicked off the NG Audio Deathmatch Auditions! @Random-storykeeper wrote an Art Inspired Music Contest 2026 Retrospective. @Pahgawk has shared his process of making art with code.Treasure Hunt winners are wrapping up and should be announced soon!SSF organizer Lee Thompson aka @Barnhouse sent me this charming collage of previous Fest photos:
